description_en: Retrieves a time-series histogram of deadlock occurrences based on the full deadlock analysis of error logs within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询时间范围内基于错误日志全量死锁分析的死锁数量趋势
kebab_example: aliyun das get-deadlock-histogram --instance-id pc-bp1u5mas9exx70000 --node-id pi-bp16v3824rt730000 --start-time 1731983066000 --end-time 1732069466000 --status SUCCESS --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDeadlockHistogram

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

Required for PolarDB for MySQL cluster instances
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds.

The maximum query window is 7 days.

<notice>

This field is of the Long type. During serialization/deserialization, precision loss may occur. Make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询开始时间最大不能早于结束时间 7 天。

<notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds.

<notice>

This field is of the Long type. During serialization/deserialization, precision loss may occur. Make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。
<notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The status of the analysis task

EndTime.description_zh: 分析任务范围的结束时间
